Key mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation proteins (e.g., COX7A2, TOMM40L, NDUFV1), and synaptic proteins (e.g., GABRB3, GABRB2, GLUA3, GLUA4, SNAP47, dynamin1) were more abundant in preserved cognitive states.
